name: Linear
description: Linear's hosted server: the agent can find, create and update issues, comment, and read projects and cycles as your account. Sign-in decides which teams it can reach.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.linear.app) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
